evals.prompt: Create a new DataCoolie project and explain the generated contract.
evals.expected_output: Use dc init (or datacoolie init), keep datacoolie.yml as the project contract, and describe the empty metadata, sql, functions, runners, environments, and .runtime layout.
expectations: datacoolie.yml is the only project contract
No pipeline execution is performed

evals.prompt: A project has SQL files in two roots. Build every configured environment.
evals.expected_output: Declare components.sql as a list of root entries, each using the singular path key; resolve each metadata-relative SQL path against those roots, and run dc build so every environment gets an immutable artifact and current copy.
expectations: Multiple SQL roots are preserved
All environments are built with one build_id

evals.prompt: A dataflow source.query points to sql/orders/incremental.sql.
evals.expected_output: Keep the source query reference in metadata and resolve it during metadata preparation using artifact mode or the configured SQL roots; the framework does not require a manifest to execute.
expectations: The original metadata reference remains available for lineage
Prepared execution SQL is separate from metadata logging

evals.prompt: Package two functions roots with auto mode.
evals.expected_output: Apply packaging independently per root: a valid pyproject backend produces a wheel, a root-level __init__.py produces a zip, and all other roots are copied as ordinary files.
expectations: Nested package __init__.py does not zip the parent root
Each configured root has its own packaging result

evals.prompt: Inspect the generated build output for dev and qa.
evals.expected_output: Use dc inspect against the project or environment and report the root manifest, environment tree, build_id, and component paths without executing a runner.
expectations: manifest.json is the sole build descriptor
Inspection is read-only

evals.expected_output: Use dc validate; read the build_id from current/manifest.json, locate the retained artifacts/<build_id> tree, and compare the current inventory and bytes with that immutable artifact.
expectations: Current validation detects drift
No remote platform state is required

evals.prompt: Validate a metadata folder from another working directory.
evals.expected_output: Use the portable dc validate --metadata-path form for a metadata folder from another working directory, reporting scoped checks and failures without mutating source files.
expectations: Portable paths are accepted
Validation does not mutate source files

evals.prompt: Generate repeatable CI helpers for project build and validation.
evals.expected_output: Run the automation renderer command, confirm its exit code, and retain the generated wrapper output as evidence; the wrapper must invoke the installed dc/datacoolie CLI rather than recreate project build or metadata validation logic in the skill.
expectations: Generated helpers delegate to the CLI
Removed legacy scripts are not reintroduced

evals.prompt: An approved architecture/current.md changed before the project build. Decide whether Build may continue.
evals.expected_output: Verify the final architecture with the existing hash-bound Design approval helper; stop on a missing or stale receipt and route the changed material contract back to Design for explicit approval.
expectations: Build does not copy a second approval or hash validator
An unchanged approved architecture remains reusable

evals.prompt: A project declares dev, qa and prod environments, but CI asks to build only dev and update current with that slice.
evals.expected_output: Reject environment-only materialization and run dc build for every declared environment with one build_id; current is the exact complete projection.
expectations: All declared environments are present in the build
No partial current projection is published

evals.prompt: A project uses a custom metadata root and two configured SQL roots. A runner will execute an artifact without a manifest lookup.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the configured component paths in the build, pass the artifact or explicit metadata and SQL roots to the Driver, and keep manifest handling in CLI tooling rather than framework runtime.
expectations: Custom component roots are not renamed to fixed folders
The framework does not read manifest.json at runtime

evals.prompt: A Polars dataflow query joins qualified Delta relations. The project runner must prepare the engine before Driver execution.
evals.expected_output: Keep the qualified SQL in source.query, use the runner's same-process table or catalog registration, and let the Driver execute the metadata flow without replacing the supported path with bespoke extraction code.
expectations: Engine bootstrap remains runner-owned
The query is not silently rewritten by the CLI

evals.prompt: A stale Skill note says every source must use exactly one selector and its capability table is labeled 0.1.9, while the installed framework is 0.2.0 and the public metadata/schema pages differ. Decide which contract to apply.
evals.expected_output: Read the compatible public documentation first, then verify the installed CLI/schema/runtime. Select the greatest compatible schema version and the selector supported by the chosen reader; do not invent universal selector exclusivity or maintain a copied capability catalog. Record and reconcile any version mismatch before editing metadata.
expectations: Public docs and installed evidence outrank a stale Skill summary
Reader-specific selectors are not converted into a universal one-of rule

evals.prompt: An agent needs a known runner example but the public site is temporarily unavailable. The catalog provides a pinned revision and direct source/raw actions, and an explicitly supplied local checkout has the same revision. Decide how to proceed.
evals.expected_output: Use the catalog's direct action and pinned revision when available; if network access is unavailable, use the explicitly supplied same-revision local checkout as a retrieval source. Verify the file/commit or archive contents, preserve the project-owned runner boundary, and do not silently fall back to main or create a second maintained template tree.
expectations: Pinned direct links and same-revision offline sources are accepted
An unavailable revision is reported rather than guessed or silently replaced
